name: bytedesk
description: ByteDesk's Claude and Codex marketplace — orchestration, design systems, architecture, project management, and platform engineering plugins.

plugins.name: fleet
plugins.description: Parallel multi-session Claude orchestration. Spawn agents on tickets, run them in parallel git worktrees, watch a dashboard, get push notifications when reviews land or merges happen. Hierarchical authorization (ADR-0001) lets parent agents delegate to children safely.

plugins.name: agent-orchestration
plugins.description: Cross-provider agent orchestration — spawn, steer, observe, cancel, and collect Claude Code, Codex, Grok Build, and Kimi agents through one durable MCP control plane.

plugins.name: design-patterns
plugins.description: Source-neutral design-pattern advisor with Markdown catalog, MCP tooling, smell scans, and architecture decision support.

plugins.name: structurizr
plugins.description: Enterprise C4 modeling with Structurizr DSL — indexed language reference, CLI/MCP tooling, 32 skills, validation gates, pattern catalog, and cookbook recipes.

plugins.name: platform-dev
plugins.description: ByteDesk core implementation lifecycle — TDD engineer, feature start, PR-ready, worktree operator, architect, grounding, integration branches.

plugins.name: platform-architecture
plugins.description: Structurizr C4 drift gate, partition decomposition facade, ADR authoring.

plugins.name: platform-frontend
plugins.description: ByteDesk Web design system, atomize, browser smoke gate, SignalR realtime.

plugins.name: platform-domain
plugins.description: Bounded-context proof operators — DBA, tool actions, Office workflows, DevProjects, remote gateway.

plugins.name: platform-ops
plugins.description: Production release policy (TeamCity read-only) and Gitflow/Fleet operator.

plugins.name: bytedesk-goals
plugins.description: ByteDesk goal pipeline — goals board, run_goals, plan_goal/plan_epic, Jira/Confluence skills, named-agent dispatch.

plugins.name: omnigent-dev
plugins.description: Omnigent cross-repo engineering — operator, architect, runtime harness, web deploy, API/SDK, agent bundles.

plugins.name: task-management
plugins.description: Takes over Claude Code's task system — native task calls, approved plans, decisions and commits mirrored into a git-tracked markdown store at .bytedesk/task-management/. One store per project shared across git worktrees, claim-based parallel work with node_modules sharing, an MCP server, and a live dashboard.

plugins.name: agentconf
plugins.description: Capability-tested configuration for AI coding agents. One shared instruction source wired into every agent on the machine, with a canary that proves each tool actually reads it instead of assuming the write landed. Never reads credential files.

plugins.name: knowledge-management
plugins.description: OKF v0.2 knowledge runtime for coding agents — git-tracked markdown bundles at .bytedesk/knowledge/, km CLI, progressive-disclosure hooks, MCP search/validate, lint/doctor, soft links to task-management.

plugins.name: teamcity-mcp
plugins.description: TeamCity CI/CD over MCP — the full REST API: trigger and monitor builds, tail/grep build logs, test failures and build problems, queue control, projects and build configs, agents, mutes, investigations. stdio + streamable HTTP transports.

plugins.name: design-system
plugins.description: Adopt and govern the ByteDesk design foundation in one command, with runtime wiring, drift-safe CI, migration, and reviewed design workflows across Claude and Codex.
